name: greenhouse_climate_dynamic
title: Dynamic greenhouse climate model with weather lookup
summary: Six-day simulation (Brussels TMY, 10-15 Dec) of the climate of a Venlo tomato greenhouse: air, canopy, cover, floor and five ground layers as dynamic nodes plus the air vapour pressure, heated by a pipe rail under proportional control, with roof vents opening above the set-point; weather and set-points are read from an hourly lookup table.

verification.summary: The 145-row trajectory (10 states, hourly output) agrees with an independent RK4 integration (h = 30 s, same equations, hourly linear interpolation of the same table): temperatures within 0.0031 K, T_air within 0.0014 K, VP_air within 0.019 Pa over six days.
verification.reference: greenhouse_climate_dynamic_ref.py in this folder (RK4, h = 30 s); same equations as CSL-0333 with capacitances
verification.notes: max_rel_diff is the largest relative deviation of the ten states over the trajectory (T_can). Q_pip, set by the controller from T_air, stays within 0.15 W/m2. The deviation is the integration step (CoolSolve RK4 h = 120 s vs reference h = 30 s). 2026-11-10: floor balance corrected (-q_rad_flr_cov) and the trajectory re-checked. The 8 min run of that day is obsolete: RK4 at 120 s is 0.57 s, BDF at 1e-4 is 0.12 s within 0.03 K (README, Solving time).

related_external: Greenhouses Modelica library, example Greenhouse_2 (source of the translation; stays in its own repository)
